title: MUIF Semantic Contract
description: A Semantic Contract: a semantic license on knowledge (see 04-core-concepts/Contract.md).

kind.description: Contract type in the Semantic Contract hierarchy.

purpose.description: The explicit purpose the contract authorizes. SEMANTIC.

parties.description: Identities party to the contract (treated as a set).

permissions.description: What the contract permits (treated as a set).

restrictions.description: What the contract forbids (treated as a set).

terminationConditions.description: Conditions under which the contract terminates.
